service.description: The count of screens the Tools home shows, as Tools › Artifact summary counts them (each root screen of the webapps with every screen below it), without making the page wait for it. Counting walks every screen and so loads each definition: about two seconds the first time in a process and a few milliseconds after. So this answers the count kept in the cache tools.home.counts (null when there is none yet), and when there is none or it is ten minutes old it calls count#Screens on a worker, once: counting is true from then until that count is kept.

Count the screens under the root screens of the webapps, each root with every screen below it, and keep the count for get#ScreenCount (the cache tools.home.counts, key screens, the JSON text of {count, time}). A root that does not load is logged as an error and left out.
